_readme: Single source for every project: /projects/ cards + 'Live on the web' list, the home/studio/post links tagged data-project, and the terminal (assets/js/projects-data.js). Edit here, then run: python tools/build_projects.py && python tools/stamp_assets.py. 'url' is the live URL; an action href of '@url' means 'use url'. Set 'unavailable' to a short note to pull a project's link everywhere without deleting it. 'clip' names a gameplay loop in site/assets/clips/<clip>.webm/.mp4 (tools/capture_clips.js); live projects get a status chip automatically. thumb.fit: 'cover' (crop to the card box at thumb.focus, a CSS object-position), 'contain' (whole image on the tinted panel) or 'phone' (a portrait phone screen standing on the panel, running off the bottom edge). 'arcade': {'order': n} puts a game on /arcade/ (n = position), where it can be played in a sandboxed frame on the page; add 'embed': false for a game whose site refuses to be framed (it then only gets 'Open in new tab'). Embeds must live on *.dillon-eu-green.workers.dev, the only frame-src the CSP in site/_headers allows.

projects.name: Linework
projects.pitch: A lightweight CAD editor in your browser: open DXF and DGN drawings, measure, redline and edit them, then save back to DXF or DGN. Nothing ever leaves your device.

thumb.alt: Linework in dark mode: a house floor plan with dimensions, room labels and red markup: revision clouds, arrows and a callout.

projects.launch_line: Opening Linework. Your drawings never leave this device.
projects.desc: CAD viewer + editor for DXF and DGN, in the browser (open linework)

projects.name: Fernwood
projects.pitch: A cozy side-scrolling farm-and-explore RPG: dig, farm, fish and make friends in a valley that's almost too generous.
projects.more: Rent the little cottage at the edge of Fernwood and settle in: plant and water a farm, dig down into the caves, fish the river, craft and decorate, and get to know the townsfolk through four seasons of birthdays, rainy nights and a lantern festival everyone can't stop talking about. Cozy on top. Something about Fernwood is a little off, and it's up to you how far you dig. Pixel art drawn in code, a canvas tile renderer, and pure, tested game rules.

thumb.alt: Fernwood: a sunny spring morning in the village, a farmer in a straw hat by the notice board, Mira outside her cottage, a tall pine and the general store.

projects.launch_line: The cottage at the edge of the valley is yours now. Mind the creaky floorboard.
projects.desc: Fernwood: cozy farm-and-explore RPG with something a little off (play fernwood)

projects.name: Little Airfield
projects.pitch: Cozy isometric airport builder: clear planes to land, hunt squawks, grow a grass strip into an airport. Best in landscape on phones.

thumb.alt: Little Airfield: an isometric grass airfield with a paved runway, a parked trainer and a plane taxiing in.

projects.launch_line: Airfield traffic, windsock favors runway two-seven. Cleared to land. (Best in landscape on a phone.)
projects.desc: Little Airfield: cozy isometric airport builder (play airfield)

projects.name: Little Airfield on Roblox
projects.pitch: Little Airfield in 3D on Roblox: grow a grass strip into a Mega Hub, then fly your own planes into it, from a Cub to a twinjet airliner.
projects.more: Planes land, taxi in and park for you to tie down, fuel and fix. Fly your own fleet: barrel rolls, cargo drops, water-bombing fires, a seaplane, a helicopter and an airliner you have to actually land, with PAPI lights and jet callouts. Luau with Rojo; the game rules are pure and unit-tested, and automated Studio playtests fly 15 missions on autopilot every run.

thumb.alt: Little Airfield on Roblox: a red Cub flying low over a busy airport, with a giant rubber duck, a control tower and planes parked on the apron.

projects.desc: Little Airfield on Roblox: airport tycoon you can fly (waiting on Roblox to go public)

projects.name: Mixtape Drift
projects.pitch: A cute pixel street racer where the music is the race: drive to the beat and the song fills in.
projects.more: Drums and bass always play; clean driving, near misses, on-beat boosts and drifts released on the beat bring in keys, lead and sparkle, and a bump drops a layer. Cruise (endless, collect cassettes), Sprint (race three rivals through one song, GO on the downbeat) and Groove, plus a Garage for shape, paint, underglow and decals. Three original songs played by a small WebAudio synth band composed in code, a music clock driving the beat timing, a low-res scanline road renderer and pixel art drawn in code, with pure rules, track and composer modules under Node tests and Playwright browser checks.

thumb.alt: Mixtape Drift: a pink pixel-art car on a neon city highway at night, under a LOFI FM 88.3 billboard, with the hint 'Boost on the beat. Let go of a drift on the beat.'

projects.launch_line: Tape in. Count-in on the downbeat: one, two, three, four. Drift on the beat.
projects.desc: Mixtape Drift: pixel street racer, music is the race (play mixtape)

projects.name: Dragon Realm Online
projects.pitch: Real-time multiplayer isometric browser MMO-style game with chat, trading and duels.
projects.more: Live position sync, chat, trading and duels over hibernating WebSockets on Cloudflare Durable Objects, with a player-to-player market stored in D1. About 11k lines.

thumb.alt: Dragon Realm Online: an isometric city square full of named characters, with health and mana orbs and a skill bar.

projects.desc: Dragon Realm Online: real-time multiplayer browser game (play dragonrealm)
projects.launch_line: Realm gate open. Mind the duelists in the square.

projects.name: Smart Mirror
projects.pitch: A Raspberry Pi magic mirror with a cyberpunk streak, run by a zero-dependency Python server.
projects.more: A monitor behind two-way acrylic and a browser UI in a self-starting Chromium kiosk. Weather, calendar, news and household notes posted from phones by QR code, with live push. It greets whoever is home by pinging their phones on Wi-Fi, so nothing leaves the LAN, and a PIR sensor wakes the screen. Easter eggs: a MIRROR-OS boot, katakana rain when it is actually raining, and a fake netrunner intrusion.

thumb.alt: Smart mirror in its cyberpunk theme: clock, rain forecast, calendar, notes and headlines, with katakana rain.

projects.desc: Raspberry Pi smart mirror, cyberpunk edition

projects.name: dillongreen.dev
projects.pitch: Framework-free portfolio: static HTML, CSS and JS on Cloudflare Pages, with Pages Functions and D1 for the guestbook and studio form, a strict CSP, cookieless analytics, an in-browser ARINC 429 decoder and a hidden terminal with MIRROR-OS easter eggs. Built by directing AI coding agents, held to automated checks: cross-engine mobile overflow and layout-shift tests in Chromium and WebKit, form and XSS tests, link checks.

thumb.alt: The dillongreen.dev home page: name, intro, resume and contact buttons, and the ARINC 429 bit-flipper.
